title: Vie Glow — Learn to Tattoo & Book with Van Ngo
description: Beginner micro-tattoo workshops and fine-line tattoo booking with Van Ngo, based in British Columbia.
hero_heading: Where beauty meets the artist's line.
hero_heading_italic: Ink becomes poetry upon the skin.
hero_text: Beginner-friendly micro-tattoo workshops with premade stencils and a safety-first approach — no experience needed. Van also takes on a limited number of clients for fine-line, minimalist tattoo work.
hero_image_alt: Van teaching students at the Vie Glow studio
paths_eyebrow: Two ways to work with Van
paths_heading: Learn the craft, or get tattooed by her directly

paths.title: Micro-Tattoo Workshops
paths.text: Beginner-friendly, informational workshops using premade stencils. Safety-focused, no prior experience required. Based in BC, with sessions also offered in Winnipeg.

paths.title: Fine-Line Tattoo Booking
paths.text: A limited number of client appointments for delicate, minimalist tattoo work — small-studio, one-on-one, no rush.

closing_text: Book a workshop spot or a tattoo appointment on the same calendar.
